name: tExplode
description: Explode a column of lists or dicts into multiple rows, optionally normalising dict values into columns (pandas explode + json_normalize).
usage: ``column`` is the list/dict column to explode. ``explode_dataset`` expands dict values into separate columns; ``drop_original`` removes the source column. ``advanced_mode`` enables parent-index tracking, empty-list preservation and column propagation — only then does ``propagate_columns`` apply.

attributes.name: column
attributes.description: Name of the list- or dict-valued column to explode.

attributes.name: drop_original
attributes.description: If ``True``, remove the source column from the result. Default ``False``.

attributes.name: explode_dataset
attributes.description: If ``True`` (default) and the values are dicts, expand them into separate columns via ``json_normalize``.

attributes.name: advanced_mode
attributes.description: Enable enhanced processing: parent-index tracking, empty-list preservation, and column propagation (concatenates parent + exploded child rows).

attributes.name: propagate_columns
attributes.description: Parent column names whose values are copied onto each child row. Only applies when ``advanced_mode`` is ``True``.
